description: Runs the cre.capital stack builder on a deal: senior loan, mezzanine, preferred equity and the common equity left over, with an optional one-tier JV split. Returns each layer's amount, share of cost and attachment/detachment LTV and LTC, blended cost of capital, cost of debt and preferred, common equity IRR and multiple, unlevered IRR, senior and all-debt DSCR, coverage including pref current pay, debt yields, LP and sponsor IRRs, the exit and the yearly cash flows. Rates you leave out start from the current 10-year Treasury plus Altus Group Q2 2026 average quotes. Arithmetic on your inputs, not a quote or a projection.

exit_cap_pct.description: Exit cap rate in percent applied to the next year's NOI, e.g. 7. Default 7.

hold_years.description: Hold period in whole years, 1 to 30. Default 5.

hurdle_pct.description: Cumulative, non-compounded preferred return to the JV partners in percent. Default 6.

lp_share_pct.description: LP share of the common equity in percent; 0 or 100 turns the JV split off. Default 90.

mezz_amount.description: Mezzanine loan amount in dollars (interest only). Default 0.

mezz_rate_pct.description: Mezzanine rate in percent. Default: 10-year Treasury + 759 bp (Altus Q2 2026, fixed mezzanine).

noi.description: Year-one net operating income in dollars, e.g. 1400000.

noi_growth_pct.description: NOI growth per year in percent, e.g. 3. Default 3.

pref_amount.description: Preferred equity amount in dollars. Default 0.

pref_current_pct.description: Part of the preferred return paid currently, in percent; the rest accrues to the exit. Default 8.

pref_rate_pct.description: Preferred return in percent. Default 13.57 (Altus Q2 2026, fixed preferred equity).

promote_pct.description: Promote to the sponsor above the preferred return, in percent of the remaining cash. Default 20.

sale_cost_pct.description: Sale costs in percent of the sale price. Default 2.

senior_amort_years.description: Senior amortization in years; 0 means interest only. Default 30.

senior_amount.description: Senior loan amount in dollars, e.g. 11000000. Use 0 for no senior loan.

senior_rate_pct.description: Senior loan rate in percent. Default: 10-year Treasury + 195 bp (Altus Q2 2026, 10-year fixed, LTV up to 65%).

total_cost.description: Total cost in dollars: price plus closing costs plus capex, e.g. 20000000.

value.description: As-is value or price in dollars, used for the LTV figures. Defaults to total_cost.

name: capital_stack
title: Build a CRE capital stack
